content: Geeshsha Dunkaane Tokethi
Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
“Koyro ageenan, koyro gallasan, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya toka.
Tammu kiitata oykida Caaqo Taabotiya iya giddon wothada, iya sinthan magarajuwa kaqa.
Xarpheezaa gaathi gelsada, koshshiya miisheta ubbaa iya bolla wotha. Xompe wothiya kocaa gelsada iya bolla xompeta wotha.
Ixaane cuyisiya worqa xarpheezaa Caaqo Taabotiya sinthan wotha. Geeshsha Dunkaaniya penge magarajuwa kaqa.
Xuugetiya yarsho bessi Geeshsha Dunkaaniya sinthan wotha.
Meecha keriya Geeshsha Dunkaaniyapenne yarsho bessaafe giddon wothada, iyan haathe kuntha.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyape karera dabaaba yuushsha aatha giigisada, magarajuwa Dunkaaniya penge bolla kaqa.
“Yaatada, geeshsha zaytiya ekada, Geeshsha Dunkaaniyanne iya giddon de7iya ubbaba tiyada, dummaya; I geeshshi gidana.
Kaallada, xuussa yarsho bessinne iyan go7etiya miishe ubbaa tiyada, dummaya; I polo geeshshi gidana.
Meecha keriyanne iya wothiya miisheta tiyada, dummaya.
“Aaronanne iya nayta Geeshsha Dunkaaniya penge ehada haathan enta meecca.
Kahine ma7uwa Aarona mayzada, I taw kahinetethan oothana mela iya tiyada, dummaya.
Iya adde naytaka ehada shamize mayza.
Enti taw kahinetethan oothana mela, enta aaway tiyetidaysada, entaka tiya. He tishsha gaason, yaana laytha ubban, enti taw kahine gididi oothana” yaagis.
Musey, ubbaba Goday kiitidaysada oothis.
Hessa gisho, enti Gibxefe keyida nam7antho laythan, koyro ageenan, koyro gallasan Geeshsha Dunkaaniya tokis.
Musey, Dunkaaniya tohota essis, tuuqeta, liyootanne tuussata aathis.
Goday kiitidaysada, Musey, garsa kamaanne bolla kamaa Dunkaaniya bolla kammis.
Yaatidi, tammu kiitata oykida nam7u loche shuchata, Taabotiya giddon wothis. Tooho kaso mithata Taabotiya sagaayotan aathis; nagara atotetha kamaka Taabotiya bolla wothis.
Taabotiya Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelsidi, geshe magarajuwa kaqis. Yaatidi, Goday kiitidaysada, Caaqo Taabotiya kammis.
Musey, xarpheezaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelsidi, magarajuwafe karera, pudeha baggan wothis.
Goday kiitidaysada, Godaa sinthan wothiya geeshsha daabbuwa iya bolla wothis.
Xompe wothiya kocaa, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelsidi, xarpheezape sintha baggara Geeshsha Dunkaaniyas dugeha baggan wothis.
Goday kiitidaysada, Musey, Godaa sinthan xompeta oythis.
Musey, worqa yarsho bessa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelsidi, magarajuwafe sintha baggara wothis.
Goday kiitidaysada, sawiya ixaane iya bolla cuyisis.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya pengen magarajuwa kaqis.
Xuugetiya yarsho bessi, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya penge sinthan wothis. Goday kiitidaysada, iya bolla xuussa yarshonne katha yarsho yarshis.
Meecha keriya Geeshsha Dunkaaniyapenne yarsho bessaafe giddon wothidi, iyan haathe kunthis.
Musey, Aaroninne iya nayti banta kushiyanne tohuwa iyan meecetidosona.
Goday kiitidaysada, enti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya geliya wode woyko yarsho bessi shiiqiya wode hessa oothosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyanne yarsho bessa yuushshi aathidi dabaaba giigisidi, he dabaaba pengen magarajo kaqis. Hessada oothidi, Musey oosuwa polis.
Godaa Bonchuwa
Hessafe guye, shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya kammis; Godaa bonchoyka iya kumis.
Shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya kammida gishonne Godaa bonchoy iyan kumida gisho, Musey iya giddo gelanaw danda7ibeenna.
Isra7eeleti banta de7iya bessaa yeddidi, baanaw dendey, he shaaray Dunkaaniyape dendiya wodena.
Shin shaaray dendonna ixiko, enti banta de7iya bessaa yeddidi bookona.
Godaa shaaray gallas gallas Geeshsha Dunkaaniya kammees, qamma qamma qassi shaara giddon tamay eexees. Isra7eele asay biya wode ubban he shaara be7oosona.
